answer: An answer must include the first 27 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the nadir derivation is checked against the meadow nonce, the pigment audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 185 aliases produces 185 mismatches and burns the authoring cost with no payout. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
